_comment: Six race findings across six rounds, but at two unrelated seams: three sites import the mailbox write module, three import the task store. They must classify as TWO classes of three rounds, each gated at its own primitive — merging them would name a seam most of the findings never call.

The row is read before the await and `writeSessionMessage` runs after it, so a concurrent archive wins the race and nothing revalidates the row in between.
